comment: Per-directory deletion rules for archive_rotate.py --retention (see docs/research_lab/data_catalogue/RETENTION.md). A server file is only ever removed if it is in a verified release with an identical sha256; these rules only say how old it must be and which small files stay. Directories without a rule are never deleted. GATE: snapshots/ moved to rules 2026-10-17 after backend/scripts/retention_gate_check.py printed retention_gate PASS on the host (04:39Z). book_sweeps/ stays deferred until q0035 (J4-R) is done and the MC1 q0111 panel is cached. cb1_extract/, cb2_extract/, cb3_extract/, cb4_extract/ are never deleted (no rule).
